results.title: Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU) 2024-25 Admission, Courses, Fees, Placement
results.content: Home » Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU) 2024-25 Admission, Courses, Fees, Placement. # Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU) 2024-25 Admission, Courses, Fees, Placement. ## Explore Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU) for its diverse academic programs, vibrant campus life, scholarships, and world-class infrastructure. Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU) is one of the premier institutions offering postgraduate and research education in the country. NAAC graded it as “A++” and recognized as a “University of Excellence” by the University Grants Commission (UGC). In the latest NIRF Ranking 2024, JNU has secured the position of the best university in India, considered as the second in the sequence. For the undergraduate students who were looking for admission in the undergraduate course at JNU UG, the second merit list of JNU UG for 2024 has now been placed on the official portal of the university. The third round of cutoffs will be published if any number of seats remain vacant after the completion of the second round of the seat allotment process.
